description:
The stack version was created on 2024‑03‑18 at 14:27:05 UTC (timestamp 2024‑03‑18T14:27:05Z). It corresponds to project iteration 42 and project step 7, with all snapshot data stored under the root directory `/mnt/data/stack_snapshots/v5`. The voxel dimensions for this version are 0.125 µm in X, 0.125 µm in Y, and 0.5 µm in Z.  

The primary change in this release is an adjusted Z‑resolution to improve depth accuracy, and we have also added metadata to support the newly introduced imaging modality. These updates are summarized in the version notes: “Adjusted Z-resolution for improved depth accuracy and added metadata for new imaging modality.”
